newsitem.title: USA: Ginnie Mae sets $155 mln REMIC 1997-01.
newsitem.headline: Ginnie Mae sets $155 mln REMIC 1997-01.

text.p: The Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA or Ginnie Mae) said it issued $155 million of Real Estate Mortgage Investment Conduit (REMIC) securities.
REMIC 1997-01 is backed by 7.5 percent GNMA I certificates, Ginnie Mae said. It priced December 17 and has a settlement date of January 30, the agency said.
The issue is sponsored by Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc and co-sponsored by Blaylock & Partners LP, Ginnie Mae said.
